note: Gate file. Every thing in the game that can make a sound, mapped to its sound-list rows. tools/audio_check.py --events reads the sources below and fails when one of their events, states, attacks, features, screens, settings rows or menu actions has no key here, when a key names a sound that is not a live row, when a row is in no key, and when a row has no style family in pipeline/audio/style.json. At run time the Feedback Adapter prints `AUDIO: event key=<key> sound=<id> t=<s>` for each key it handles; `--log` fails a key that fired with sound=none, an unknown key or a sound that is not mapped to it. `silent` needs a reason and is only for things that never make a noise in the shipped game. `pending` is only for a feature that is not approved yet (EXPERIMENT, PROPOSED, DEFERRED in docs/feature-manifest.json); it fails the moment the feature is approved.

sources.event: docs/feature-manifest.json `events` and the event list in pipeline/unreal/gameplay-code.md
sources.state: GDD SH1.0 MOVE-19: the four Shoot / Absorb modes
sources.attack: the pipeline/level/encounter.json baseline preset attacks (GDD SH1.0 section 5)
sources.ui: pipeline/ui/menus.md menu actions: focus, Confirm, Back, Quit
sources.signal: pipeline/ui/signals.json: each sound_id must be a live row (ui_check.py signals checks the rest)

event:AnimationCue.silent: carries the sound of the action it cues

event:BackgroundLooped.silent: a background layer wraps; no sound

event:CatchAttempt.silent: an internal check; its outcome plays CatchSucceeded or nothing

event:CatchFailed.silent: a missed catch is silent; the shot keeps flying (its own sounds)

extra:level-and-hazards.why: Director's Cut level, enemies and hazards (GDD SH1.0 section 5)

extra:other.why: spells, story, progression, ambience and music rows not tied to one source key
